cards.title: Too Long Have These Peasants Stood
cards.gameText: If a [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, hinder all conditions.
cards.lore: The rabble of Dunland pillaged their way across the Mark.

cards.title: Forearmed
cards.gameText: Reveal the top card of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card. If that minion is now 4 strength or less, discard the revealed card.

cards.title: Naith Troop
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot 3 Elf companions. Skirmish: Exert Naith Troop to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, make a minion skirmishing Naith Troop strength -2.
cards.lore: Now only the bow and the sword can forestall the coming of the Shadow.

cards.title: Naith Warband
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot 3 Elf companions. While Naith Warband bears a ranged weapon, it takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase and does not add to the fellowship archery total.
cards.lore: “‘But do not think that only by singing amid the trees... is Lothlórien maintained and defended....'”
